broad_gate_attempts.failure: Three disk_kv_store_spec fixtures overlapped and exhausted the 7.7 GiB /tmp tmpfs.
broad_gate_attempts.classification: test-environment resource contention; each failing assertion reported ENOSPC

broad_gate_attempts.command: timeout 15m env TMPDIR=/home/wyatt/.cache/aeordb-test-tmp cargo test -j 4 -p aeordb --test disk_kv_store_spec -- --test-threads=1
broad_gate_attempts.classification: isolated rerun confirmed the default broad-gate failures were tmpfs pressure

broad_gate_attempts.reproduction: timeout 5m env TMPDIR=/home/wyatt/.cache/aeordb-test-tmp cargo test -j 4 -p aeordb --test symlink_ecosystem_spec test_gc_with_symlink_and_snapshot -- --exact --test-threads=1
broad_gate_attempts.root_cause: GC dereferences every value whose length equals the hash length as a hard link. A valid /link -> /target SymlinkRecord serializes to exactly 32 bytes and is misread as a Blake3 hash.
broad_gate_attempts.disposition: Freeze as a deterministic entry-baseline defect and correct it in a separate implementation commit before Child 01 P0b.

limitations: These are local debug-mode characterization values, not release or production service SLOs.
Temporary databases live on tmpfs, so the probes do not characterize durable disk latency.
Maximum RSS is the timed command-process maximum and can include rustc during a compile-skewed run.
P0a does not mutate or benchmark an evidence or production database.
Native macOS/Windows and copied-production measurements remain later phase gates.
